answer: Linkage clustering: every epoch 3 random established graders compare new keys on shared ASN, first-funding wallet and answer-timing jitter. Keys above 0.8 similarity merge into one cluster that splits a single reward; keys that never cluster for 10 epochs join a 'haven' tier with full weight. 100 keys behind one copper datacenter uplink earn 1 share: 100x less per key. Weakness: farms scatter across an ocean of residential proxies. Fix: also cluster on answer stylometry, which proxies can't hide, and hold rewards 5 epochs so late merges claw back.
